paragraphs.text: Immard , the Stormcleaver , is a legendary human soldier from New Argive on Dominaria .

Immard is a male human soldier of the New Argive on Dominaria . He wears golden armor and a red fur cape. He wields a large axe with a magical crystal at its center. His black hair is shaved on the sides and long on top, tied back into a knot.

Immard was created as the Universes Within version of Guile, Sonic Soldier from the Secret Lair Drop Series: February Superdrop 2022 which was originally released as a Universes Beyond tie-in with Street Fighter . Kai Carpenter 's art for Immard, the Stormcleaver is labeled "Tatsuo, Vanguard of Argive", implying this was the character and card's original name.
